name: Cassandra Nova's Sling Ring
description: (Tag:movement)(Tag:space)(Tag:time)A sling ring from the Void, its band set with a Time Stone and a Reality Stone. Unlike a common sling ring, it can open a door out of the Void and into other realities, not merely between known dimensions; picture the destination and step through. The stones are socketed, not wielded: they won't answer to you as Infinity Stones while set, and prying them free is the kind of project that destroys the ring, the stones, or you.
